description: For each archival status, count the distinct projects with QC records of that status. Each share is that count divided by the sum of these counts. Return the statuses whose share is above the average share, with the status, count, share and share minus average.

c.request: In the QC data, tally the projects under each archival status (`archstat`), with a missing status treated as its own group. Work out each status's share as its tally divided by the sum of the tallies over all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. Show the status, the tally, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, with no rounding. For each archival status, count the distinct projects with QC records of that status. Each share is that count divided by the sum of these counts. Return the statuses whose share is above the average share, with the status, count, share and share minus average.
c.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT SUM(project_count) as total_projects
  FROM status_counts
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.archstat,
    sc.project_count,
    sc.project_count::FLOAT / tc.total_projects as share,
    tc.total_projects
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT 
  ss.archstat,
  ss.project_count,
  ss.share,
  ss.share - ac.avg_share as share_above_average
FROM status_shares ss
CROSS JOIN average_calc ac
WHERE ss.share > ac.avg_share
ORDER BY ss.share DESC;

a.request: For each archival status (`archstat`) in the QC data, with a missing status treated as its own group, count the distinct projects (`arcref`) that have QC records with that status. Work out each status's share as that count divided by the sum of the counts over all statuses. Return only the statuses whose share is above the average share across statuses. Show the status, the count, the share, and how far the share is above the average share, with no rounding.
a.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(archstat, 'missing') AS status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'missing')
),
with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    project_count,
    SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS num_statuses,
    project_count::NUMERIC / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS avg_share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT 
  status,
  project_count,
  share,
  share - avg_share AS above_average
FROM with_stats
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC

b.request: Count distinct projects in scanqc records for each archstat value (treating NULL as a separate group), compute each status's share as its project count divided by the total project count, and return statuses with above-average share, displaying status, project count, share, and share minus average share.
b.sql: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'NULL') as archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), total_projects AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) as total FROM project_counts), with_share AS (SELECT pc.archstat, pc.project_count, CAST(pc.project_count AS FLOAT) / tp.total as share FROM project_counts pc CROSS JOIN total_projects tp), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_share) SELECT ws.archstat as status, ws.project_count, ws.share, ws.share - avs.avg_share as share_minus_average FROM with_share ws CROSS JOIN average_share avs WHERE ws.share > avs.avg_share ORDER BY ws.share DESC
b.raw: Count distinct projects in scanqc records for each archstat value (treating NULL as a separate group), compute each status's share as its project count divided by the total project count, and return statuses with above-average share, displaying status, project count, share, and share minus average share.

d.request: For each archival status in the QC data (treating NULL/missing as a status), count the distinct projects, calculate each status's share as its project count divided by the total project count across all statuses, filter to statuses with share above the mean share, and return the status, project count, share, and share minus mean share with no rounding.
d.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(project_count) as total_projects
  FROM status_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.archstat,
    sc.project_count,
    sc.project_count::numeric / (SELECT total_projects FROM total_stats) as share
  FROM status_counts sc
),
mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as mean_share
  FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  ws.archstat,
  ws.project_count,
  ws.share,
  ws.share - mc.mean_share as share_minus_mean
FROM with_shares ws
CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc
WHERE ws.share > mc.mean_share
ORDER BY ws.share DESC
